logoSources.notes: Official site favicon (750x750 JPEG: blue '3A' with white outline on orange). Scaled down so the mark sits inside the circle-safe area, on the favicon's own orange (#EB6B00). Local copy: tools/seed/logo-src/tiendas3a/tiendas3a-favicon.jpg.

Official site header logo (orange house shape, '3A' + cart + 'HARD DISCOUNT', transparent PNG 1000x575), trimmed and resized to 512 px wide. Local copy: tools/seed/logo-src/tiendas3a/01_Logo_3A_Nav.png.

notes: Hard-discount chain of Grupo AJE (site footer: 'Compañía AJILES PERU S.A.C.'); brand also styled 'Tiendas de Ahorro 3A' / '3A Hard Discount'. Brand colours from the official logo PNG: orange #FF6A00, blue #1226AB. storeCountReported = number of stores returned by the official store-locator API behind tiendas3a.pe/ubicanos on 2026-09-30 (268: province LIMA 247, CALLAO 19, CAÑETE 1, HUAROCHIRI 1); raw snapshot saved in tools/seed/raw/tiendas3a-locator-2026-09-30.json (API field coordenadax = latitude, coordenaday = longitude). Press: Peru Retail, 2026-04-24, 'sumar 240 tiendas en Lima' (https://www.peru-retail.com/tiendas-3a-acelera-su-expansion-con-la-apertura-de-un-nuevo-local-cuantos-ya-suma/). OSM (Overpass probe 2026-10-01): only ~3 tagged stores in all Peru ('Tiendas 3A', '3A', '3A Hard Discount', all shop=convenience, none with brand:wikidata) -> the official locator is the main source for this chain. Name regex is anchored on purpose: '3A' alone is very common ('3A Dent' dentist, '3A Salón & Estética', '3A Amseq', street addresses like '3A-11'); it only accepts '3A', '3 A', '3A Hard Discount…', 'Tienda(s) [de Ahorro] 3A…'. Legend name '3 A' as written on the user's Lima slides.
